# Functional trait diversity in marsupials: comparing Australia and the Americas


## 1. Research question and hypothesis

### Research question 

Due to the different environment and the compose of animals in Australia and America, there are different natural resorces. This difference causes the difference niches occupied by marsupials in both regions. The main question of the research is: Is there actually more internal differences in Australian marsupials than American marsupials? What kind of trait the difference is mainly associated with and is this kind of difference depart from the phylogentic null model? 

### Hypothesis 

1. Australian marsupials have more internal differences, measured jointly using diet tpye, foraging stratum and body mass. It is still bigger in the same diet group.

2. This kind of difference depart fron the phylogentic null model.

### 2.3 match taxonomy and phylogeny

In this part, I cleaned the data and standardised species names. I removed missing names and replicated name–ID combinations. Then matched the names with MDD database and the tree.

```{r}
# Keep names that identify exactly one MDD record.
mdd_names <- mdd %>%select(mdd_id = id,
    sciName,
    MSW3_sciName,
    mdd_extinct = extinct,
    diffSinceMSW3,
    countryDistribution,
    continentDistribution)


mdd_names <- mdd_names %>% pivot_longer(
    c(sciName, MSW3_sciName),
    values_to = "Scientific"
  ) %>%
  select(-name)


mdd_names <- mdd_names %>%
  mutate(Scientific = normal_name(Scientific))

# delete empty value
mdd_names <- filter(
  mdd_names,
  !is.na(Scientific),
  Scientific != "",
  Scientific != "NA")

# When the same name corresponds to the same MDD ID, only one instance is retained
mdd_names <- mdd_names %>%
  distinct(Scientific, mdd_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# caculate how many records have in the same name
mdd_names <- mdd_names %>%
  add_count(Scientific)

# keep the records have only one name
mdd_names <- filter(mdd_names, n == 1) %>%
  select(-n)

head(mdd_names)


# find marsupial in the tree
marsupial_tax <- filter(tree_tax, higher == "Marsupialia",
  Species_Name %in% source_tree$tip.label)

# keep marsupial in the tree and cut the tree
marsupial_source_tree <- keep.tip(
  source_tree,
  marsupial_tax$Species_Name)

# find species did not extinct and in the tree
tree_names <- filter(
  tree_tax,
  extinct. == "0",
  Species_Name %in% marsupial_source_tree$tip.label)

# match tne name and tree tips

tree_names <- tree_names %>%
  mutate(Scientific = normal_name(Species_Name),tree_tip = Species_Name) %>%
  select(Scientific, tree_tip)

head(tree_names)

# match the MDD data with traits data
mars = inner_join(mars_raw, mdd_names,by = "Scientific")

mars <- filter( mars, mdd_extinct == "0", diffSinceMSW3 == "0")
# match the records with the tree
mars <- inner_join( mars,tree_names, by = "Scientific")
```

### 2.4 select regions and traits

```{r}
# define america and diet 

american_families <- c("Didelphidae", "Caenolestidae", "Microbiotheriidae")

diet_columns <- paste0("Diet-", c( "Inv", "Vend", "Vect", "Vfish", "Vunk", "Scav", "Fruit", "Nect", "Seed", "PlantO"))

# seperate regions

mars = mars %>% mutate(australia = str_detect(countryDistribution, "(^|\\|)\\s*Australia\\s*(\\||$)"),

    americas = str_detect(continentDistribution, "(^|\\|)\\s*(North|South) America\\s*(\\||$)" ),

    american_family = MSWFamilyLatin %in% american_families,

    region = case_when(australia & !americas & !american_family ~ "Australia",
      americas & !australia & american_family ~ "Americas" ))

# Convert dietary habits and body weight into numerical values, and calculate the sum of the dietary habit proportions.
mars <- mars %>% mutate(
    across(all_of(c(diet_columns, "BodyMass-Value")), as.numeric))

mars$diet_total <- rowSums(mars[, diet_columns])

# filter good data 

mars <- filter(mars,

  !is.na(region),
  !countryDistribution %in% c("", "NA"),

  `Diet-Certainty` == "ABC",
  `ForStrat-Certainty` == "A",
  `BodyMass-SpecLevel` == "1",

  `ForStrat-Value` %in% c("G", "S", "Ar", "A", "M"),

  is.finite(`BodyMass-Value`),
  `BodyMass-Value` > 0,

  if_all(all_of(diet_columns), ~ between(.x, 0, 100)),

  abs(diet_total - 100) < 1e-8)

# Keep not replicated records

mars <- mars %>% add_count(mdd_id, name = "id_n") %>% add_count(tree_tip, name = "tip_n")

mars <- filter(mars, id_n == 1, tip_n == 1)


# keep useful columes

mars <- mars %>%
  select(
    source_row,
    Scientific,
    tree_tip,
    region,
    `BodyMass-Value`,
    `ForStrat-Value`,
    all_of(diet_columns)
  )

mars

```


## 4. Tree analysis

### 4.1 Define the diversity statistic

```{r}
gower_summary <- function(dat, include_diet = FALSE) {

  # define log mass and stratum , put them at same weight
  traits <- data.frame(log_mass = log10(dat$`BodyMass-Value`), stratum = factor(dat$`ForStrat-Value`))

  weights <- c(1, 1)


  # when diet is added
  if (include_diet) {traits$diet_group <- factor(dat$diet_group)
    weights <- c(1, 1, 1)}


  # caculate the gower distance between all species
  gower_dist <- cluster::daisy( traits,metric = "gower",weights = weights,warnBin = FALSE )

  D <- as.matrix(gower_dist)


  # find the number of data in different regions
  au <- dat$region == "Australia"
  am <- dat$region == "Americas"

  n_au <- sum(au)
  n_am <- sum(am)


  # caculate the average distance of au
  au_mean <- NA_real_
# make sure there is at least 2 species
  if (n_au >= 2) {
    D_au <- D[au, au, drop = FALSE]
    au_distances <- D_au[lower.tri(D_au)]
    au_mean <- mean(au_distances)
  }


  # am
  am_mean <- NA_real_

  if (n_am >= 2) {
    D_am <- D[am, am, drop = FALSE]
    am_distances <- D_am[lower.tri(D_am)]
    am_mean <- mean(am_distances)
  }


  # return the results
  data.frame(n_Australia = n_au, n_Americas = n_am,mean_Australia = au_mean,mean_Americas = am_mean,  delta = au_mean - am_mean)
}
```

## 5. Null model from the tree

### 5.1 Null model functions

```{r}
# read the tree
read_analysis_tree <- function(file, species) {

  tree <- ape::read.tree(file)
  stopifnot(inherits(tree, "phylo"))

  tips <- tree$tip.label

  stopifnot(
    anyDuplicated(tips) == 0,
    all(species %in% tips))

  # Keep the species used in the analysis
  tree <- ape::keep.tip(tree, species)

  # Check the tree and its branch lengths
  branch_lengths <- tree$edge.length

  stopifnot(
    ape::is.rooted(tree),
    ape::is.binary(tree),
    length(branch_lengths) == nrow(tree$edge),
    all(is.finite(branch_lengths) & branch_lengths > 0))

  tree
}

# find the fitness

fit_tree_models <- function(tree, dat) {
  tips <- dat$tree_tip
  n_species <- nrow(dat)

  # body mass fit
  log_mass <- log10(dat$`BodyMass-Value`)
  names(log_mass) <- tips

  #  covariance matrix 
  C <- ape::vcv.phylo(tree)
  C <- C[tips, tips, drop = FALSE]

  # the ansteral body mass
  ones <- rep(1, n_species)
  weighted_mass <- solve(C, log_mass)
  weighted_ones <- solve(C, ones)
  root <- sum(weighted_mass) / sum(weighted_ones)

  # change rate of body mass
  residual <- log_mass - root
  weighted_residual <- solve(C, residual)
  sigma2 <- sum(residual * weighted_residual) / n_species

  stopifnot(is.finite(root), is.finite(sigma2), sigma2 > 0)

  # foraging stratum model
  stratum <- factor(dat$`ForStrat-Value`)
  names(stratum) <- tips

  stratum_fit <- phytools::fitMk(tree, stratum, model = "ER", pi = "equal" )

  # diet model
  diet <- factor(dat$diet_group)
  names(diet) <- tips

  diet_fit <- phytools::fitMk(tree, diet, model = "ER", pi = "equal")

  # 4. Check convergence  
  rates <- c(stratum_fit$rates, diet_fit$rates)

  stopifnot(
    stratum_fit$opt_results$convergence == 0,
    diet_fit$opt_results$convergence == 0,
    all(is.finite(rates)),
    all(rates >= 0)
  )

  # results
  Q_stratum <- unclass(phytools::as.Qmatrix(stratum_fit))
  Q_diet <- unclass(phytools::as.Qmatrix(diet_fit))

  parameters <- tibble(root_log_mass = root, sigma2 = sigma2,  q_stratum = unname(stratum_fit$rates[1]), q_diet = unname(diet_fit$rates[1]))

  list(root = root,
    sigma2 = sigma2,
    Q_stratum = Q_stratum,
    Q_diet = Q_diet,
    parameters = parameters
  )
}



# simulate the tree gower

simulate_tree_gower <- function(tree, dat, model, n_sim) {
  tips <- dat$tree_tip
  groups <- as.character(group_gower$group)

  # simulate traits on the tree
  mass_sim <- phytools::fastBM(
    tree, a = model$root, sig2 = model$sigma2, nsim = n_sim
  )
  mass_sim <- 10^mass_sim 

  stratum_sim <- phytools::sim.Mk(tree, Q = model$Q_stratum, nsim = n_sim)
  diet_sim <- phytools::sim.Mk(tree, Q = model$Q_diet, nsim = n_sim)

  stopifnot(
    setequal(rownames(mass_sim), tips),
    setequal(rownames(stratum_sim), tips),
    setequal(rownames(diet_sim), tips),
    all(is.finite(mass_sim) & mass_sim > 0),
    !anyNA(stratum_sim),
    !anyNA(diet_sim)
  )

  # results
  runs <- vector("list", n_sim)
  sim_dat <- dat

  for (i in seq_len(n_sim)) {
    sim_dat$`BodyMass-Value` <- mass_sim[tips, i]
    sim_dat$`ForStrat-Value` <- as.character(stratum_sim[tips, i])
    sim_dat$diet_group <- as.character(diet_sim[tips, i])

    tables <- list(Overall = gower_summary(sim_dat, include_diet = TRUE))

    for (g in groups) {
      in_group <- dat$diet_group == g
      tables[[g]] <- gower_summary(sim_dat[in_group, , drop = FALSE])
    }

    one_run <- bind_rows(tables)
    one_run$group <- names(tables)
    one_run$simulation <- i
    runs[[i]] <- one_run
  }

  result <- bind_rows(runs)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(result) == n_sim * (1 + length(groups)),
    all(is.finite(result$delta))
  )

  result
}

```


### 5.2 select trees

```{r}
tree_dir <- "Completed_5911sp_topoCons_FBDasZhouEtAl"

tree_files <- list.files( tree_dir, pattern = "\\.tre$", full.names = TRUE)

# number of trees and simulations
n_trees <- 100
n_sim_per_tree <- 100

stopifnot(length(tree_files) == 10000, n_sim_per_tree >= 2)

# select 100 tree randomly
selected_files <- sample(tree_files, size = n_trees)

# Extract the four-digit tree ID from each file name
tree_id <- sub(
  ".*_tree([0-9]{4})\\.tre$",
  "\\1",
  basename(selected_files))

# table of trees selected
tree_plan <- data.frame(
  tree_file = selected_files,
  tree_id = tree_id
)

head(tree_plan)
```

### 5.3 Run simulations

```{r}
tree_runs <- vector("list", nrow(tree_plan))

for (j in seq_len(nrow(tree_plan))) {
  id_j <- tree_plan$tree_id[j]
  message("Tree ", j, "/", nrow(tree_plan), " (", id_j, ")")

  tree_j <- read_analysis_tree(tree_plan$tree_file[j], mars$tree_tip)
# order the table
  tip_order <- match(tree_j$tip.label, mars$tree_tip)
  dat_j <- mars[tip_order, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(dat_j$tree_tip, tree_j$tip.label))

  # make the simulation
  model_j <- fit_tree_models(tree_j, dat_j)
  sims_j <- simulate_tree_gower(tree_j, dat_j, model_j, n_sim = n_sim_per_tree)

  tree_runs[[j]] <- list(
    simulations = mutate(sims_j, tree_id = id_j),
    parameters = mutate(model_j$parameters, tree_id = id_j)
  )
}
```

### 5.4 chec kthe results

```{r}
simulated_gower <- bind_rows(lapply(tree_runs, function(run) run$simulations))


sim_counts <- table(simulated_gower$tree_id, simulated_gower$group)

# check
stopifnot(
  setequal(rownames(sim_counts), tree_plan$tree_id),
  setequal(colnames(sim_counts), c("Overall", group_gower$group)),
  all(sim_counts == n_sim_per_tree)
)
```


## 6. The null model 

### 6.1 The null distribution

```{r}
null_data <- left_join (simulated_gower, select(observed_gower, group, delta_obs), by = "group")

# summary by group
null_summary <- null_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    delta_expected = mean(delta),
    sim_sd = sd(delta),
    sim_low = quantile(delta, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    sim_high = quantile(delta, 0.975, names = FALSE),

    p_sim = {
      n_lower <- sum(delta <= delta_obs)
      n_upper <- sum(delta >= delta_obs)
      min(1, 2 * (min(n_lower, n_upper) + 1) / (n() + 1))})
null_summary
```


### 6.2 compare the observation with expectation

```{r}
comparison_table <- left_join(observed_gower, null_summary, by = "group")

# calculate the p value
comparison_table <- comparison_table %>%
  mutate(
    SES = if_else(
      sim_sd > 0,
      (delta_obs - delta_expected) / sim_sd,
      NA_real_
    ),
    p_sim_BH = p.adjust(p_sim, method = "BH")
  )

(comparison_display <- comparison_table %>%
  transmute(
    Group = group,
    Observed_delta = round(delta_obs, 4),
    Expected_delta = round(delta_expected, 4),
    Simulation_95_interval = sprintf("[%.4f, %.4f]", sim_low, sim_high),
    SES = round(SES, 2),
    p_sim = format.pval(p_sim, digits = 3, eps = 0.0001),
    p_sim_BH = format.pval(p_sim_BH, digits = 3, eps = 0.0001)
  ))

```

### 6.3 plot

```{r}
poster_null <- comparison_table %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = rev(c("Overall", poster_diets))),
    analysis = factor(
      group == "Overall",
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
      labels = c("Overall: 3 traits", "Within diet groups: 2 traits")
    )
  )

p_null <- ggplot(poster_null, aes(y = group)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +

  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = sim_low, xmax = sim_high),
    orientation = "y",

    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(x = delta_obs, shape = "Observed"), size = 3) +

    breaks = c("Observed", "Model mean")
  ) +

  facet_grid(analysis ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  labs(
    title = "Observed differences and model expectations",
    x = "Mean Gower difference (Australia − Americas)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    caption = "Grey bars show the central 95% of simulated differences under the BM + Mk model."
  ) +
  poster_theme

p_null
```


## 7. PCoA plot

```{r}
pcoa_plot <- function(dat, include_diet = FALSE, title = "PCoA") {

  traits <- data.frame(
    log_mass = log10(dat$`BodyMass-Value`),
    stratum = factor(dat$`ForStrat-Value`)
  )

  if (include_diet) {
    traits$diet_group <- factor(dat$diet_group)
  }

  D <- cluster::daisy(traits, metric = "gower", warnBin = FALSE)
  fit <- ape::pcoa(D, correction = "lingoes", rn = dat$Scientific)

  if (is.null(fit$vectors.cor)) {
    axes <- fit$vectors
    percent <- 100 * fit$values$Relative_eig
    caption <- "Gower distances"
  } else {
    axes <- fit$vectors.cor
    percent <- 100 * fit$values$Rel_corr_eig
    caption <- "Lingoes-corrected Gower distances"
  }

  plot_data <- mutate(dat, PCoA1 = axes[, 1], PCoA2 = axes[, 2])

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, colour = region)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_equal() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = poster_colours) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", percent[1]),
      y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", percent[2]),
      colour = "Region",
      caption = caption
    ) +
    poster_theme

  if (include_diet) {
    p <- p + aes(shape = diet_group) + labs(shape = "Diet group")
  }

  p
}

pcoa_plot(mars, include_diet = TRUE, title = "Overall PCoA")

for (g in poster_diets) {
  group_data <- filter(mars, diet_group == g)
  plot_title <- if (g == "Omnivores") "Omnivores / residual category" else g

  print(pcoa_plot(group_data, title = plot_title))
}
```

## Phylogeny

```{r}
tree_colours <- c(Australia = "#BCEB0C", Americas = "#892F99")

tips <- analysis_tree$tip.label
tip_rows <- match(tips, mars$tree_tip)
tip_regions <- as.character(mars$region[tip_rows])

node_colours <- c(
  tree_colours[tip_regions],
  rep("grey60", analysis_tree$Nnode)
)

edge_colours <- node_colours[analysis_tree$edge[, 2]]
edge_colours[is.na(edge_colours)] <- "grey60"

ape::plot.phylo(
  analysis_tree,
  type = "fan",
  show.tip.label = FALSE,
  use.edge.length = TRUE,
  edge.color = edge_colours,
  edge.width = 2.5,
  tip.color = "black",
  cex = 0.7,
  label.offset = 0.012 * max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(analysis_tree)),
  no.margin = TRUE
)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = names(tree_colours),
  col = tree_colours,
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 3,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.95,
  inset = 0.015
)
```
